candidate_rows.label: Source-qualified event identity and reference
candidate_rows.boundary: Not globally unique Event ID alone; do not equate event identity with message identity. CMPT uses Event Reference to connect update and recall Events to a previously published Event. An Event without Event Reference is treated as original; a referenced Event without Recall is an update, and Recall identifies a recall. Preserve this lineage without equating reference with message identity or deleting the cited record.

candidate_rows.label: Event occurrence time
candidate_rows.boundary: Not Header transmission time, processing time or an inferred original resultTime. CMPT requires publishing the Event within500ms of making the observation. That is a message-send latency bound; it does not redefine Event.time, which remains the occurrence time, or guarantee network receipt within500ms.

candidate_rows.label: Event creation category
candidate_rows.boundary: Required marking and the stated Other default coexist in the source; no encoding omission rule is assumed.

candidate_rows.label: Detector property context at event occurrence
candidate_rows.boundary: Not every device property, a new sensor, or a guaranteed complete event-time state snapshot. CMPT permits relevant detector-property values that changed since the last Status to accompany an Event and explicitly says this does not count as a Status update. Event context therefore cannot replace the separate Status state-reporting stream.

candidate_rows.label: Component capability and readiness report
candidate_rows.boundary: Declarations and readiness/reporting states remain distinct from current Status values and performed work. ICD7.3 says a modifiable property is marked mutable in the CCD; clearing it makes it Not Ready,and not-ready properties must be Not Reporting and absent from Status. The DMS Clear Property precondition remains a value previously supplied through Set Property; its null-value consequence is retained. This does not establish deletion of historical data or physical absence. IPL3 declaration representations do not change the saved DMS declaration contracts. CMPT requires initial Config within 30 seconds of ADDED. L-0058 includes the CCD and all false capability-state values; L-0061 includes the entire CCD when declarations change; L-0062 includes all false state values when states change and explicitly describes an empty state list when all states become true. This is not an arbitrary sparse patch rule or a universal Boolean default. Updates retain the source’s all-connected-components versus connected-Controller wording. Configuration updates have a 30-second send limit. M-0031 separately requires property changes after configuration-set changes; L-0082 ties its full reporting-true Status to an update Config containing a CCD, and L-0170 gives that full Status a 30-second limit. These source levels do not establish a full-Status trigger for every state-only update. On REVIVED, CMPT requires a complete configuration set and a Config send within30 seconds of the revival notification. This is recovery traffic, not evidence that configuration was accepted, deployed or physically realized.

candidate_rows.label: Component property-value report
candidate_rows.boundary: Distinct from a Get Status request, Config states and Event observables. ICD 6.5 gives general Status publication bounds through Minimum/Maximum Status Interval and contextual significant change. The saved DMS Threshold Declaration also specifies threshold publication regardless of status interval; retain both source statements without inventing precedence. IPL3 encodes standard properties as optional typed fields and custom properties through the named-value structure; list presence is separate from list contents. The DMS Status.properties list remains unchanged. CMPT initial Status includes every ready-and-reporting property and is due within 30 seconds of sending initial Config. Periodic Status includes all and only changed ready-and-reporting property values; a never-reported value is treated as changed. L-0093’s 500 ms response is conditional on a reporting-true property change after no periodic Status within the Minimum Status Interval, not a universal period. L-0082’s CCD-update Status instead says every reporting-true property; preserve that qualification difference. The saved Get Status command separately retrieves declared ready properties even when reporting is disabled. M-0037’s explanatory Note says these interval restrictions apply only to Status publication; the ICD separately reuses the named interval properties for command-response cadence. CMPT non-responsiveness recovery uses a500ms Status response. Higher-level text says full status, while L-0100 explicitly selects declared properties with ready=true and reporting=true; retain that source-level wording difference instead of silently broadening the message to every declared property.

candidate_rows.label: Registration message and credential data
candidate_rows.boundary: Registration.credentials is application-message data; it is distinct from the TLS certificate required by the ICD connection rules and the Certificate Guide trust/usage context. The saved DMS fields specify no automatic registration success or particular credential scheme. Possessing a certificate does not by itself establish a permitted command,successful registration or verified deployment security. CMPT-M-0018/L-0054 sends REQUEST ADD after successful format negotiation/Handshake Complete. M-0019 places the 30-second submission limit after successful negotiation; L-0055 says after establishing a connection. The connected-state Note and both anchors remain literal, without an invented reconciliation or a 30-second guarantee of successful admission.

candidate_rows.label: Command request identity and response reference
candidate_rows.boundary: ICD6.7.1 explicitly requires Response.reference to equal the command Request ID and the Envelope To field to address the caller. The preserved DMS309 text says Identifier of the Request message without naming request id; retain that source-specific wording and the separate Request.identifier field. No invented identifier equality,conversion or executed exchange is claimed. CMPT-L-0144 repeats the explicit Response.reference=Request ID rule. Request uniqueness is the source UCI + request ID + time combination. These requirements reinforce correlation without collapsing Request.identifier, request id and message identity.

candidate_rows.label: Request access-control metadata
candidate_rows.boundary: Not an authorization decision, a specified policy language, credentials already validated or a device interlock.

candidate_rows.label: Conversation-scoped message identifier
candidate_rows.boundary: Not the event key, request id or persistent equipment identity.

candidate_rows.label: Message priority
candidate_rows.boundary: Not measurement quality, confidence or an equipment safety classification.

candidate_rows.label: Message-data validity expiry
candidate_rows.boundary: Not guaranteed deletion, archive/query accessibility expiry or automatic observation result time.

candidate_rows.label: Exchange sender and intended recipients
candidate_rows.boundary: Distinct from the original author of each message, the detector, or a cryptographically authenticated principal.

candidate_rows.label: Exchange transmission time
candidate_rows.boundary: Not event occurrence, original measurement production, reception time or Bennett resultTime.

candidate_rows.label: Administrative network and service notification
candidate_rows.boundary: Not a performed sensing observation; no extra Alarm ID field is introduced. CMPT announces virtual-component availability changes with DEVICE ADDED/DEVICE REMOVED and cites the virtual component as subject. The source leaves the determination of permanent unavailability to the interface between representative and virtual component.

candidate_rows.label: Message author or registration announcer
candidate_rows.boundary: Not automatically Header.from, the observed object, the hardware sensor or verified issuer identity. For virtual components, CMPT requires the virtual component to be cited as message source in Config, Status, Event and Response messages sent on its behalf. Source attribution therefore need not identify the network participant that physically transmitted the message.

candidate_rows.label: Declared component capability catalogue
candidate_rows.boundary: Not current values, readiness, execution, or mandatory support for every catalogue item. CMPT-M-0022–0025 declares all executable commands, reportable properties/observables and custom types that might be used. L-0058/0061 and L-0064/0066/0068/0070 require complete declarations in an included CCD; L-0071 permits only one instance of each declaration. Complete CCD content remains distinct from changed-value Status and false-state-list content. The custom-type Note says composed of existing types; it does not supply a new schema or prove built-in-only composition.

candidate_rows.label: Declared property definition
candidate_rows.boundary: Not a reported value, write permission for a particular caller, or current ready state.

candidate_rows.label: Declared observable definition
candidate_rows.boundary: The source says reported observables should be declared; do not strengthen should into shall. CMPT-M-0024/L-0068 separately uses shall for declaring all reportable/supported observables in the initial/included CCD. The DMS definition’s should wording remains preserved in its evidence; each modality is attributed to its source instead of silently substituting one for the other. Declared support still does not imply every Event contains the observable.

candidate_rows.label: Declared command interface
candidate_rows.boundary: Not an issued request, completed operation, or proof of runtime availability.

candidate_rows.label: Declared command parameter
candidate_rows.boundary: An optional argument is distinct from optionality of its declaration metadata.

candidate_rows.label: Declared command result
candidate_rows.boundary: Do not silently replace Range with Range Declaration or claim a result has actually been produced.

candidate_rows.label: Declared custom data structure
candidate_rows.boundary: Not an untyped arbitrary payload, a registry policy, or an automatically approved domain-model class.

candidate_rows.label: Declared field within a custom structure
candidate_rows.boundary: Preserve required optional:Boolean plus printed FALSE default without inventing wire omission rules.

candidate_rows.label: Declared built-in or custom value type
candidate_rows.boundary: Type Name membership alone does not establish implementation support; descriptive typos do not create aliases.

candidate_rows.label: Declared value shape and collection bounds
candidate_rows.boundary: No absent maximum becomes zero; no-field Single Structure does not mean a null value; a data tree is not hardware composition.

candidate_rows.label: Declared permitted or excluded values
candidate_rows.boundary: Not sensing reach, operating thresholds, measurements, or invented precedence among overlapping restrictions.

candidate_rows.label: Declared property mutability
candidate_rows.boundary: Not caller authorization, ready/reporting state, or proof of modification; retain the native WRITE ONLY wording.

candidate_rows.label: Absolute-value publication threshold
candidate_rows.boundary: Not a validity limit, quality assessment, detected threat, or proof that a trigger fired.

candidate_rows.label: Relative-change publication threshold and reference basis
candidate_rows.boundary: Not an absolute limit or physical lifetime history; current reading and last reported value are not interchangeable.

candidate_rows.label: Declared property publication triggers
candidate_rows.boundary: Not command execution, validation failure, or an invented Boolean combination/trigger algorithm.

candidate_rows.label: Human-facing component category
candidate_rows.boundary: Do not infer supported commands, sensing modes or a hardware inheritance hierarchy from a category.

candidate_rows.label: Unattended ground sensor category
candidate_rows.boundary: Not automatic inheritance under Component Category or verified performance of a particular sensor.

candidate_rows.label: Four-valued evaluation state
candidate_rows.boundary: Not a replacement for Boolean readiness or a fabricated numerical confidence scale.

candidate_rows.label: Power-source classification
candidate_rows.boundary: Not remaining energy, charge level, measured power or a guaranteed supply quality.

candidate_rows.label: Video-enhancement algorithm category
candidate_rows.boundary: Not proof of applied processing, physical optical behavior or a specified output resolution.

candidate_rows.label: Route-segment alternatives
candidate_rows.boundary: Not network routing, geographic polyline equivalence or evidence of executed movement.

candidate_rows.label: End-of-route action category
candidate_rows.boundary: No invented route-generation, repeat-count or execution guarantee.

candidate_rows.label: Current command execution record
candidate_rows.boundary: Not a capability declaration, readiness flag, request submission or proof of final success. CMPT distinguishes validation error, FAILED decline, BUSY, QUEUED, IN PROGRESS, SUCCESS and execution failure. Near-real-time initial response is due within200ms; non-real-time and queued/long-running response cadence reuse the performing component's status-interval properties. Response state remains evidence of command processing, not proof of a measured physical effect.

candidate_rows.label: Nominated component/contact identity record
candidate_rows.boundary: The source calls this a user identifier; retain its nominated standing. No credentials, authentication or new universal hardware identity is implied.

candidate_rows.label: Detection and identification distance limits
candidate_rows.boundary: Not an observed target distance or the simpler Range property. Omitted effective defaults to maximum and minimum to 0.0 only in this native structure.

candidate_rows.label: Reported value and associated uncertainty
candidate_rows.boundary: Most Measured types explicitly require a plus/minus one-standard-deviation error convention. Count, Humidity, UTC and Measured Psecpm3 do not state that convention. Missing error is not zero or exactness; no conversion or normal-distribution assumption.

candidate_rows.label: Source-message reference for provenance
candidate_rows.boundary: Not an Event Reference, proof of authentic authorship, a new observation or an automatic equality with Request.request id.

candidate_rows.label: Named value payload
candidate_rows.boundary: No standalone type field is invented in Name Value Pair. The generic DMS uses named values in Status,Event and Request payloads; IPL3 gives standard properties/observables typed fields and standard commands dedicated request structures,while custom content retains generic named structures. Semantic name/value meaning need not use the same encoded field shape. A named value is not a physical transducer or proof of a performed observation.

candidate_rows.label: Named-value associative collection
candidate_rows.boundary: Not a hardware hierarchy or a guessed JSON-object encoding; declaration and instance remain distinct.

candidate_rows.label: Declared-type value list
candidate_rows.boundary: Not a list of component children and not a substitute for List Structure declaration bounds.

candidate_rows.label: Custom-structure field values
candidate_rows.boundary: Not Custom Type Declaration or proof that an extension is a core standard type.

candidate_rows.label: Recursive same-type value hierarchy
candidate_rows.boundary: Not physical composition, containment or a platform hierarchy. Required children with None omission prose is retained for encoding reconciliation.

candidate_rows.label: Video-frame detection details
candidate_rows.boundary: Pixel coordinates are not geographic coordinates. Selection for slewing is not executed motion; suggested labels are not a closed enumeration.

candidate_rows.label: Video-derived entity track reference
candidate_rows.boundary: Not a temporal track history, component identifier or guaranteed geographic position for every detection.

candidate_rows.label: Requested message kinds and returned fields
candidate_rows.boundary: Named selection lists are Required 0+; optional priority/stale and Config ccd flags default false. Textual select status means all fields in the guide; do not equate omitted textual clauses with unpopulated object fields. The Position example also states a field-presence condition; do not generalize it to every selection. CMPT component discovery sends a Discover Request with the desired query to the targeted Live Data Service. When a Live Data Service recommendation was received, using it is should, not shall. This requirement does not change Data Query semantics or prove a discovery result.

candidate_rows.label: Message-matching criteria
candidate_rows.boundary: And/Or require one or more inputs; Not has exactly one. Preserve the guide grammar rather than assuming familiar operator precedence. XOR-to-object translation is not supplied. exists() literally returns true for an empty value; no silent inversion.

candidate_rows.label: Field navigation and contextual filtering
candidate_rows.boundary: False predicates remove the current object or node from context. Recursive paths are query navigation, not physical composition. Retain the grammar distinction between field and explicit-context selectors.

candidate_rows.label: Query functions and arguments
candidate_rows.boundary: Function names do not establish commands or executable equipment controls. The grammar permits positional as well as named arguments; the guide does not specify how unnamed arguments populate required Function Parameter.name.

candidate_rows.label: Literal and list query values
candidate_rows.boundary: List Value contains Value[0+]; Static Value contains exactly one Wildcard. Retain misleading battlefield-entity prose without converting these query containers into an entity model. concat and unique describe list operations, not observation fusion.

candidate_rows.label: String matching rules
candidate_rows.boundary: String Match recognizes only *, ? and backslash as special pattern characters; exact-match describes boundary anchors. It is not a listed Match union alternative and is not assumed equivalent to regexp() or an unrestricted regular-expression engine.

candidate_rows.label: Subscription identity and query definition
candidate_rows.boundary: All five fields across the two structures are required single values. The identifier is not just a label or number. Keep subscription description distinct from Add/Remove Subscription requests and from evidence that delivery actually occurred. CMPT Add Subscription requests carry desired filters and a locally unique name; Remove Subscription cites the subscription ID and the Live Data Service instance where the subscription was created. Recommended Live Data Service use is should. Definition, command exchange and delivered subscription data remain distinct.

candidate_rows.label: Subscription selection and initial-cache options
candidate_rows.boundary: The guide spells the strict option differently in prose and examples; neither spelling is silently chosen as implementation truth. without cache concerns initial returned context, not deletion of cached data, a ban on cached lookup functions or archival History semantics.

candidate_rows.label: Message-source and cached-component query context
candidate_rows.boundary: component() uses Administrative About UCIs. Cached lookups use source, or About for Administrative context. Events are not cached: get_event returns the active Event or an empty list. These functions are not Get Config/Get Status command execution.

candidate_rows.label: Spatial component and message selection
candidate_rows.boundary: The near-UCI function defaults minor axis to major axis, rotation to zero and positionless inclusion to false. in_area distinguishes source positions, Administrative About components and Event detection area/position. No coordinates, distance interpretation or common position semantics are invented from an example.

candidate_rows.label: Service role and required command support
candidate_rows.boundary: Six DMS service definitions are not six mandatory Controller modules. SDD 4.2.1 requires each ISA 6.0 Controller to support all three core services, while support and activation are distinct; 5.0 separately describes typical hosting. Any component may provide optional services. Empty property/observable columns do not prohibit additional capabilities. Support, activation, provider selection, authorization, request, execution and achieved effects remain separate. CMPT service recommendations are conditional on needing a service. Set Live Data Service and Set Authorization Service support is likewise conditional; recommendation receipt does not prove activation, provider binding or successful service use.

candidate_rows.label: Capability group membership
candidate_rows.boundary: Membership does not create mutually exclusive equipment classes, prove installation or readiness, or require every listed item on every component. Required and Recommended carry separate explicit support language. Per-member core/extension standing and existing definition questions are retained.

candidate_rows.label: Required and recommended capability support
candidate_rows.boundary: Required lists two interval properties and seven commands; Recommended lists Identity, Operating State, Clear Property and Set Property. This is a source obligation, not a test result or a claim that any case component conforms. Retain must versus should. The DMS baseline remains two required properties and seven required commands. CMPT §4.1.3 separately recommends Identity and Operating State, makes Set Observable Reporting conditional on publishing observables, and requires Set Property for settable properties. Its READ WRITE note does not erase the DMS WRITE ONLY value. Conditional shall and should retain their stated scope; no case-component conformance is inferred.

candidate_rows.label: Network participation role and responsibilities
candidate_rows.boundary: The initiator is the client and the non-initiator is the server for that connection. Controller is a service responsibility and software role; it also has client-side responsibilities. These are not disjoint equipment classes, physical device counts or process counts. A visible network participant need not equal one physical device.

candidate_rows.label: Network instance and connection context
candidate_rows.boundary: The Introductory Guide local instance has one Controller and clients. SDD describes a broader network of interconnected components and Controllers over existing physical networks, with one or many Controllers in a deployment. Do not make a local instance a global one-Controller limit or infer physical containment, an actual deployment inventory, tested topology or mandatory full-mesh connectivity.

candidate_rows.label: Extension standing and standardization context
candidate_rows.boundary: DMS inclusion does not erase extension standing. The described nomination period is not automatic promotion, and Accepted does not itself mean a current core definition. Preserve native wording and edition; no owner DIM adoption or present-day release status is inferred.

candidate_rows.label: Composition member exposure and source attribution
candidate_rows.boundary: Composition is an integration collection, not necessarily a physical assembly. A visible member is announced, has declared capabilities and periodic status; a non-ISA member made visible is a virtual ISA component. Opaque does not mean its capabilities are absent. This is network representation, not independently verified physical provenance or the DMS laser Visible property. CMPT §4.3.15 calls represented non-ISA-interface entities virtual ISA components and requires network announcements/configuration/status/observation handling on their behalf. This strengthens the network-representation interpretation, not physical part-of, independent certificate ownership or direct ISA connectivity.

candidate_rows.label: Externally visible member taskability
candidate_rows.boundary: Visibility, declared support, taskability, requester authorization, execution and successful effects are separate. Figure 2 labels incoming Member B tasks although B is translucent; only C has a forwarded task arrow. Preserve that tension without inventing task forwarding to or execution by B.

candidate_rows.label: Composition interface task mediation role
candidate_rows.boundary: These are contextual responsibilities for a request, not mutually exclusive equipment classes, a permanent actor taxonomy, a specified algorithm or proof of completed execution. A CIC need not be a Controller. CMPT virtual-command behavior explicitly allows execution on behalf, translation to an equivalent non-ISA message, or forwarding an ISA Request, with queueing and response handling around those choices. The Note gives implementation forms, not a mandatory transport or permanent actor class.

candidate_rows.label: Connection-specific network participation lifecycle
candidate_rows.boundary: The six phases describe ISA participation, not physical asset life, equipment health or command execution. Periodic Status supports communication availability; missing Status does not prove physical failure. Registration renewal, nonresponsive/revived handling, deregistration and connection termination remain distinct; a connection may remain open. Figures illustrate typical and atypical paths, not an invented complete implementation. CMPT distinguishes pre-operational integration, pre-participation discovery/time setup and participation behavior. Its client-side role is the connection initiator; startup connection need is conditional, and connection attempts are at least five seconds apart. M-0032/L-0083–0088 gate Request/Event/Administrative transmission and silently discard early arrivals until the connected peer’s initial Status is received. This initial-Status operational marker remains separately attributed from the SDD initial-Config transition. A permitted IPL data exchange is not automatic permission for every ISA message or proof of hardware readiness. CMPT §4.3.7 adds explicit NON RESPONSIVE and REVIVED recovery exchanges: selected Status within500ms and complete Config within30s. §4.3.16 separately requires resource cleanup and deregistration before leaving; connection termination remains source-qualified because M-0073 says should terminate after Registration Removed while L-0168 says the connection may close and may remain open. Recovery, deregistration and socket closure are not physical asset lifecycle states.

candidate_rows.label: Negotiated message encoding and model version
candidate_rows.boundary: ICD6.0r5 supports IPL protocol version1 and lists Protocol Buffers/XML long and short forms plus0x05/0x01 Custom Java API encoding. Unsupported/deprecated format pairs and inconsistent printed examples retain their source standing. IPL3 transforms standard capabilities into dedicated declarations/fields/request types while custom content retains generic structures. Neither IPL Format3 nor its schema byte is protocol version3. No actual negotiation,schema-file validation or current security result is asserted. CMPT-L-0042/0043 requires all supported ICD formats in preference order; it adds no Controller selection rule. L-0048 requires the smallest suitable application-data wrapper, while the ICD describes best fit with should. L-0046/0051/0052 require the stated early-data, invalid-type and decode-failure errors. The Sensor CE Format 3 sentence is an explanatory Note, not a universal format mandate. Negotiation completion permits IPL data exchange subject to the later ISA participation restrictions.

candidate_rows.label: Certificate identity and trust context
candidate_rows.boundary: ICD6.0r5 requires a valid certificate under the network PKI and checks the Controller certificate Common Name against its UCI. The Certificate Guide distinguishes SDK,local testing,exercise and deployment certificates; deployment follows the deploying authority policy. This establishes source requirements,not installed credentials,verified trust,physical identity,permission for a task or current security certification. Virtual-component UCI suffixes do not imply a separate certificate for every virtual member. CMPT §4.1.2 separately requires date validity and nonrevocation. Its high/mid and low-level signer clauses respectively say ISA-approved and acceptable to the deploying organization. M-0004/L-0011 say ECDSA, while L-0013 is titled ECDSA Algorithm but says ECDH; L-0012 literally says the certificate is at least 384 bits long. These statements remain attributed without a repaired algorithm, inferred key-size field or current cryptographic recommendation.

candidate_rows.label: Supplied list value versus no update
candidate_rows.boundary: IPL3 says absent and empty lists otherwise encode alike and adds presence Booleans to Status/Event for list-based properties and observables. True indicates the associated value is supplied even when empty. The guide does not specify defaults for false or omitted flags,wire tags or an authorization decision; it does not prescribe this mechanism for every DMS list or erase list bounds/history.

candidate_rows.label: Capability readiness and reporting selection
candidate_rows.boundary: CMPT-L-0072–0081 and their explanatory Notes distinguish command enablement from immediate availability, property maintenance/access on request from publication, and observable recording enablement from inclusion in Events. A ready command may still be busy. These states do not establish authorization, execution, an observed physical effect or a measured hardware-health condition. Config false-state-list rules are source-specific message semantics, not invented defaults for every required Boolean. Saved DMS Command/Property/Observable State definitions and their wording notes remain intact. Observation publication includes only ready-and-reporting observables. Command requests are limited to declared commands whose ready state is true, yet a ready command can still be temporarily unavailable, queued or BUSY. Reporting/readiness/request eligibility and immediate execution remain separate.

candidate_rows.label: Component time basis and synchronization
candidate_rows.boundary: CMPT-H-0004 requires UTC synchronization and L-0032 states the UNIX epoch. M-0010 uses shall for NTP synchronization, with a Note allowing GPS; L-0031 uses should and calls NTP a design goal. Preserve those levels and the source definition that Notes are explanatory. The requirements supply no numerical synchronization accuracy, selected deployed clock source, measured clock quality or new DMS clock-status fields. Epoch does not determine timestamp units or collapse occurrence and transmission times; saved UTC/time type definitions retain their own rules.
